newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Swedish bond yields flat, crown firms against mark.
newsitem.headline: Swedish bond yields flat, crown firms against mark.

text.p: Swedish debt yields were little changed at midday on Monday as relief about a French opinion poll was counterbalanced by higher German yields.
The poll showed France's centre-right coalition heading for a narrow majority in next month's parliamentary elections but found that more than one-third of voters could change their minds.
The crown firmed against the mark but softened against the generally stronger dollar.
The six-month T-bill rate rose one basis point to 4.20 percent, while the ten-year bond yield was flat at 7.36.
The crown firmed to 4.5040 against the mark from 4.5130 late on Friday but softened to 7.8044 against the dollar from 7.7548 late on Friday.
Dealers expected the crown to trade between 4.49 and 4.52 against the mark.
The loss against the dollar mainly stemmed from U.S. investors buying other currencies against crowns, dealers said.
"U.S. investors have bought currencies against crowns, but we have also seen export companies buying crowns, partly counterbalancing the (crown's) softness," a dealer said.
